title: SUTI Message Schema
description: JSON Schema for SUTI (Standardized Utilization of Transport Information) messages. Version 2026 draft.

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON Schema for validation

sutiMessages.description: Array of complete SUTI messages for batch transmission

msgTypeEnum.description: Valid SUTI message type codes (centralized for reuse). Mirrors the msgType enumeration in SUTI_Message.xsd.

msg.description: Common message header for all SUTI messages

msgTimeStamp.description: Timestamp when the message was created

clientContactReference.description: Contact reference information at message level

id.description: Generic identifier with source and value

unique.description: Whether this identifier is globally unique

referenceToMsg.description: Reference to another message (must have at least one identifier)

zone.description: Description of a geographic area agreed between client and provider

node.description: A point in a route (pickup, destination, etc.)

pickupConfirmation.description: Node-event confirmation used by messages 4010 and 4040

orderTemplate.description: Repetitive order template (msg 2800, 2801, 2541, 6800). See 'How to use SUTI' 4.2 Repetitive Orders.

scheduleElement.description: One scheduled element of an order template (XSD scheduleElement, redundant name prefixes dropped)

orderListClosed.description: True indicates that no more orders exist in the list

orderReport.description: Order report (msg 6001, 2531). eventReport flattened to events[] per JSON conventions.

economyReport.description: Economic information from the vehicle (taximeter). Not necessarily equal to the settlement between client and provider.

subOrder.description: Used if the economy report is sent per suborder

nodeSeqNo.description: Used if the economy report is sent per node

summaryReport.description: Vehicle, total time and total distance of an order

vehicle.description: Vehicle that performed this order (identification in the provider system)

durationStart.description: Duration from start of order in seconds

distanceStart.description: Distance from start of order in meters

orderEnded.description: Indicates that this order is finished

deliveryNote.description: Delivery note (msg 6500). See 'How to use SUTI' 4.4 Delivery Note. eventReportDeliveryNote flattened to events[].

tour.description: Summary of a single mission to be accounted for (XSD accounting/tour, Tour-suffixes dropped)

events.description: Events not connected to a specific content (suborder)

idActivity.description: Indicates request for payment, accept payment, review payment etc

calculationFare.description: Fare calculation: either a fixed price or a taximeter amount

tourEvent.description: Accounting tour event not connected to a specific content (suborder)

price.description: Price elements (used in infoResponse 1601 and restrictions)

priceResponsible.description: Indicates if client or provider sets the price

priceValue.description: Price as set by priceResponsible (XSD attribute 'price'). Includes VAT if vatIncluded is true.

taxiMeter.description: The tariff that shall be used or is used in the taximeter

idTaxa.description: Source (src) shall refer to the used tariff of the provider

activate.description: True = taximeter shall be activated in vehicle

priceCalculation.description: Potential description of how the fare is constructed

orderLink.description: Multiple client orders combined into a shared provider order (msg 2040). See 'How to use SUTI' 4.1.1.5.

authorizationAccept.description: Answer to msg 2900 where the order is created in the provider system and the client can accept it (msg 2901). See 'How to use SUTI' 4.3 SUTI flagstops.

restrictionsType.description: Monetary or geographical restrictions for an authorization

infoRequest.description: Request for information (15xx). Repeatable request groups per XSD infoRequest.

infoRequestItem.description: A single info request: exactly one request item, optionally scoped by calendar and product

requestContent.description: Personal id or corresponding parcel id

requestPrice.description: Order skeleton describing the transport to price

requestCustomer.description: Customer id for a specific customer, or 0 for all customers

resourceAllocation.description: Request for allocation of a resource (msg 1920). See 'How to use SUTI' 4.1.2.4 Resource allocation.

resourceOrderId.description: Order number or other identifier of the task to which a resource is requested

resourceStartTime.description: Start time for the requested resource

resourceEndTime.description: End time for the requested resource

resourceAddress.description: Address where the requested resource should be at resourceStartTime

resourceDispatch.description: Resource dispatch information for vehicle login/logout

idMsgRef.description: Reference to a specific message with message metadata

idOrderForwardRef.description: References used when an order is forwarded
